rv.q: It's an evening of unadulterated bliss.

cn.t: Critics hail this RSC adaptation as a triumph, praising Tim Minchin's witty lyrics, Matthew Warchus's inventive direction, and the astonishingly talented child cast. Bertie Carvel's villainous Miss Trunchbull steals scenes in what many call the best British musical in years.
